ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows triangle WXY. Segment WY is the horizontal base. From vertex X, a dashed perpendicular segment drops to the base WY, with a right-angle marker at the foot. This dashed height is labeled 16 in. Reasoning: The area of triangle WXY is given as 248 square inches. Using the triangle area formula A = (1/2)bh, substitute A = 248 and h = 16: 248 = (1/2)(b)(16). Since (1/2)(16) = 8, this becomes 248 = 8b. Solving gives b = 248 / 8 = 31. Therefore, the base length is 31 inches.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: the shaded triangle WXY has horizontal base WY, and the dashed segment from X perpendicular to WY is labeled 16 in, so the height corresponding to WY is 16. Read from the question that the triangle area is 248 square inches. Use the idea that doubling a triangle across its base/height forms a parallelogram or rectangle-equivalent region with area base × height, so base × 16 = 2 × 248 = 496. Divide 496 by 16 to get the base length 31.
